Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: low-resolution fantasy RPG dialogue portrait, single transparent isolated head-and-narrow-collar icon. Repaint the character substantively as a new portrait, matching the four tightly cropped native-style face studies. Input 1 is identity and color reference only, not a body composition to preserve. Inputs 2–5 are style-only references Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore. Output one portrait, not a reference sheet. HARD style target: designed as a 74 by 100 pixel logical canvas, extremely simple opaque square pixel clusters, connected broad cheekbone and large nose planes, compact small dark eyes with tiny muted warm-gray whites, forceful facial construction. Use only about 24–32 muted earthy colors. No painterly smooth gradients, antialiasing, dither, hair filigree, realistic pores, high-resolution strand lines, or white eye bars. Very short neck; only a tiny narrow collar at the bottom, not shoulders or chest. The face dominates the canvas. Entire head outline and ears fully intact, with genuine empty transparent margin around hair/hat top and sides. Do not solve fit by cutting off hair or ears. Silhouette must have 3 logical pixels clear top/side margin and 2 bottom margin. Mature adult anatomy, not a child/chibi. No text, labels, watermark, frame, props, hands, background scene, or modern costume. Actual transparent RGBA background.
Subject: Wenno / 温诺 / SKO-NPC-WENNO, male medieval cooling-process maintenance worker, about fifty. Preserve clean-shaven identity, sandy light-brown tousled short hair with complete irregular crown, slate-blue tunic and tiny warm off-white rounded slit inner collar. CURRENT CARD OVERRIDES source juvenile rendering: depict a convincing fifty-year-old man with weathered broad angular cheek planes, deep-set narrow eyes, two restrained forehead/under-eye fold clusters, mildly receding temples and faint gray at temples without turning all hair white. Bigger long adult nose and jaw, no beard. Expression: matter-of-fact calm concentration, level compressed brows, quiet closed mouth, small sideways glance toward viewer-left; not angry, sad, smiling or aristocratic. Short stout neck. Current card wet-cloth shoulder wrap must be represented only as a very narrow dark desaturated blue-gray damp cloth fold at lower edge, keeping original slate blue and off-white collar recognizable; no large scarf wrapping chin. Do not relocate arm burn scars onto the face; arms/tools/gloves are outside this tight crop. Not safety officer, physician, warrior or noble.
